evidence.claim: Batch spawn X = (base & 0xFF00) | byte4 with base starting at 0x0300 and the high byte incremented between columns.
The model predicts the runtime booth positions 2016 and 2920 exactly.
Timed/deferred records spawn at cam_x+0x148 when byte5 == 0, or cam_x-8 when byte5 != 0, once their countdown expires.
Round-1 camera gates are 0x04C0, 0x07C0, 0x0AC0, 0x0DC0, 0x10C0, 0x13C0; 0xFFFF ends the stage.
Round 1 contains 7 one-player phone booths (type 0x11) as breakables.
